What was examined

i.

Date code

“8901 A2” is heat-embossed on the side strap tab. This is the late-1980s format: year 89, month 01, followed by the French factory code A2. The date fits the Epi line, introduced in 1985, and the Toledo Blue colour, produced 1985–2002.

ii.

Embossing and stamps

The Epi grain is even and continuous across the panels. The embossed LV logo on the side is crisp and correctly proportioned, and the grommets are engraved “LOUIS VUITTON”.

iii.

Stitching

Straight, evenly spaced stitching in dark thread along the trim, base and strap, with a consistent stitch length and no loose or doubled stitches.

iv.

Hardware

Solid brass D-rings, buckle and grommets with patina consistent with age. The interior zip pocket has an LV-stamped pull.

v.

Interior

Alcantara-type microfibre lining with an Epi-trimmed zip pocket, as on Noé bags of this period.

vi.

Construction

Shape, proportions, base piping and drawstring routing are consistent with the model.

Condition

Good, with visible vintage wear. Described as seen on 8 November 2026.

  • Colour loss and light whitening along the top edge and on the drawstring.
  • Scuffs and colour loss on the base corners and the lower piping.
  • Darkening and wear on the shoulder strap.
  • Tarnish and patina on the brass hardware.
  • Light marks on the interior base.
  • No tears or open seams observed.
